items.prompt:
In data processing, raw unprocessed facts and figures are referred to as:

A) Data
B) Information
C) Knowledge
D) Wisdom

Processed data that is meaningful and useful to the user is called:

A) Raw data
B) Information
C) Noise
D) A bit

The main difference between data and information is that information has been:

A) Stored on paper
B) Typed on a keyboard
C) Processed and given meaning
D) Counted in bytes

Data that consists only of numbers on which arithmetic can be performed is described as:

A) Alphabetic data
B) Alphanumeric data
C) Logical data
D) Numeric data

Data made up of letters of the alphabet only is called:

A) Alphabetic data
B) Numeric data
C) Boolean data
D) Audio data

A field that holds a mixture of letters, digits and symbols holds:

A) Numeric data only
B) Alphanumeric data
C) Alphabetic data only
D) Logical data only

Which of the following is a quality of good information?

A) Bias
B) Lateness
C) Accuracy
D) Irrelevance

Information that reaches the user in good time to be useful is said to be:

A) Obsolete
B) Encrypted
C) Redundant
D) Timely

mcq_options.text: Relates directly to the matter being considered

items.prompt:
Information is said to be relevant when it:

A) Relates directly to the matter being considered
B) Is the longest report available
C) Contains many technical terms
D) Is stored in a database
items.correct_answer: A) Relates directly to the matter being considered

items.prompt:
Data collected first-hand directly from its origin for a specific purpose is called:

A) Secondary data
B) Primary data
C) Tertiary data
D) Processed data

Data obtained from already published reports or records is called:

A) Primary data
B) Raw data
C) Secondary data
D) Live data

The value of information to an organisation lies mainly in its ability to aid:

A) File deletion
B) Power supply
C) Hardware cooling
D) Decision making

mcq_options.text: Conversion of data into useful information

items.prompt:
Data processing is best defined as the:

A) Conversion of data into useful information
B) Sale of computer hardware
C) Repair of printers
D) Drawing of organisational charts
items.correct_answer: A) Conversion of data into useful information

items.prompt:
Which of the following is NOT a stage of data processing?

A) Collection of data
B) Advertising the data
C) Processing of data
D) Output of information

Processing data entirely by hand without any machine is called:

A) Electronic data processing
B) Mechanical data processing
C) Manual data processing
D) Online processing

Processing data using computers is known as:

A) Manual data processing
B) Mechanical data processing
C) Paper-based processing
D) Electronic data processing

A major advantage of electronic data processing over manual processing is:

A) Greater speed and accuracy
B) Higher chance of human error
C) Slower output
D) Inability to store data

The smallest unit of data in the data hierarchy is the:

A) File
B) Bit
C) Record
D) Database

mcq_options.text: Byte, bit, file, record, field, database
File, record, field, byte, bit, database
Bit, byte, field, record, file, database
Database, file, record, field, byte, bit

items.prompt:
Arranged from smallest to largest, the correct data hierarchy is:

A) Byte, bit, file, record, field, database
B) File, record, field, byte, bit, database
C) Bit, byte, field, record, file, database
D) Database, file, record, field, byte, bit
items.correct_answer: C) Bit, byte, field, record, file, database

mcq_options.text: Managed and protected like other assets

items.prompt:
Describing information as a corporate resource means it should be:

A) Discarded after one use
B) Kept secret from all staff
C) Stored only on paper
D) Managed and protected like other assets
items.correct_answer: D) Managed and protected like other assets

mcq_options.text: Transform input data into meaningful output information
Increase the number of computers owned

items.prompt:
The fundamental purpose of any data-processing system is to:

A) Transform input data into meaningful output information
B) Increase the number of computers owned
C) Reduce the use of electricity
D) Replace all human workers
items.correct_answer: A) Transform input data into meaningful output information

items.prompt:
Good information should above all be:

A) False
B) Accurate
C) Hidden
D) Outdated

Unprocessed facts entered into a computer are called:

A) Reports
B) Charts
C) Data
D) Programs

A meaningful result produced after processing is called:

A) Data
B) Hardware
C) A cable
D) Information

The number system that uses only the digits 0 and 1 is the:

A) Binary system
B) Decimal system
C) Octal system
D) Hexadecimal system

The number system that uses ten digits (0 to 9) is the:

A) Binary system
B) Decimal system
C) Octal system
D) Hexadecimal system

The octal number system has a base of:

A) 2
B) 10
C) 8
D) 16

The hexadecimal number system has a base of:

A) 8
B) 10
C) 2
D) 16

The base (radix) of the binary number system is:

A) 2
B) 8
C) 10
D) 16

The binary number 1010 is equal to which decimal number?

A) 12
B) 10
C) 8
D) 20

The binary number 1111 is equal to which decimal number?

A) 16
B) 11
C) 15
D) 8

The binary number 10010 converts to which decimal value?

A) 16
B) 20
C) 9
D) 18

The decimal number 5 is written in binary as:

A) 101
B) 110
C) 011
D) 111

The decimal number 12 is written in binary as:

A) 1010
B) 1100
C) 1001
D) 1110

In hexadecimal, the letter A represents the decimal value:

A) 11
B) 12
C) 10
D) 1

In hexadecimal, the letter F represents the decimal value:

A) 16
B) 14
C) 5
D) 15

A single binary digit, either 0 or 1, is known as a:

A) Bit
B) Byte
C) Word
D) Nibble

A group of four bits is called a:

A) Byte
B) Nibble
C) Word
D) Bit

A group of eight bits is called a:

A) Nibble
B) Word
C) Byte
D) Bit

BCD, a code in which each decimal digit is represented by four bits, stands for:

A) Binary Computer Data
B) Basic Code for Data
C) Byte Coded Decimal
D) Binary Coded Decimal

mcq_options.text: Characters such as letters, digits and symbols

items.prompt:
ASCII is a coding scheme used mainly to represent:

A) Characters such as letters, digits and symbols
B) Sound waves only
C) Electric current
D) Magnetic disks
items.correct_answer: A) Characters such as letters, digits and symbols

mcq_options.text: Automatic System Code for Internet Input
American Standard Code for Information Interchange
American Symbol Code for Internal Instructions

items.prompt:
ASCII stands for:

A) Automatic System Code for Internet Input
B) American Standard Code for Information Interchange
C) Advanced Standard Computer Information Index
D) American Symbol Code for Internal Instructions
items.correct_answer: B) American Standard Code for Information Interchange

mcq_options.text: Characters from many of the world's writing systems

items.prompt:
The main advantage of Unicode over basic ASCII is that it can represent:

A) Only English capital letters
B) Only the digits 0 to 9
C) Characters from many of the world's writing systems
D) Only mathematical signs
items.correct_answer: C) Characters from many of the world's writing systems

items.prompt:
In the binary number 1000, the leftmost 1 has a place value of:

A) 4
B) 2
C) 16
D) 8

Computers represent and process all data internally using:

A) Two states (0 and 1)
B) Ten different voltages
C) The decimal digits 0 to 9
D) Letters of the alphabet

The binary number 1 is equal to which decimal number?

A) 2
B) 1
C) 0
D) 10

How many distinct digits does the decimal system use?

A) 2
B) 8
C) 10
D) 16

The hexadecimal digit set runs from 0 to 9 and then uses the letters:

A) A to Z
B) G to Z
C) A to E
D) A to F

Which of the following is NOT a valid digit in the octal system?

A) 8
B) 7
C) 0
D) 5

The physical, tangible parts of a computer system are collectively called:

A) Software
B) Hardware
C) Firmware
D) Data

Which of the following is an input device?

A) Monitor
B) Printer
C) Keyboard
D) Speaker

A device used to point at and select items on the screen is the:

A) Printer
B) Plotter
C) Monitor
D) Mouse

Which device is used to capture printed images and convert them to digital form?

A) Scanner
B) Printer
C) Speaker
D) Monitor

Which of the following is an output device?

A) Keyboard
B) Monitor
C) Mouse
D) Scanner

A device that produces a permanent copy of information on paper is a:

A) Scanner
B) Keyboard
C) Printer
D) Microphone

A soft copy of output is one that is displayed on the:

A) Sheet of paper
B) Disk label
C) Printer ribbon
D) Monitor (screen)

The part of the computer often described as its 'brain' is the:

A) Central processing unit (CPU)
B) Monitor
C) Keyboard
D) Printer

The three main parts of the CPU are the control unit, the registers and the:

A) Monitor
B) Arithmetic and logic unit
C) Hard disk
D) Power supply

The unit within the CPU that performs calculations and comparisons is the:

A) Control unit
B) Monitor
C) Arithmetic and logic unit (ALU)
D) Keyboard

The CPU unit that directs and coordinates the activities of the computer is the:

A) Arithmetic and logic unit
B) Hard disk
C) Printer
D) Control unit

mcq_options.text: Volatile memory that loses its contents when power is off
Permanent storage that keeps data forever

items.prompt:
RAM (Random Access Memory) is best described as:

A) Volatile memory that loses its contents when power is off
B) Permanent storage that keeps data forever
C) An input device
D) A type of printer
items.correct_answer: A) Volatile memory that loses its contents when power is off

mcq_options.text: Erased whenever the computer is switched off
Non-volatile and retains its contents when power is off

items.prompt:
ROM (Read Only Memory) differs from RAM mainly because ROM is:

A) Erased whenever the computer is switched off
B) Non-volatile and retains its contents when power is off
C) Used only for printing
D) Larger than any hard disk
items.correct_answer: B) Non-volatile and retains its contents when power is off

items.prompt:
Which of the following is a secondary (backing) storage device?

A) ALU
B) Control unit
C) Hard disk
D) RAM only

An optical storage medium read by a laser is the:

A) Floppy disk
B) RAM chip
C) Keyboard
D) CD-ROM

A USB port on a computer is used mainly to:

A) Connect peripheral devices
B) Cool the processor
C) Display images
D) Store the operating system permanently

The case that houses the CPU, memory and other main components is the:

A) Monitor
B) System unit
C) Keyboard
D) Mouse

A touch screen is unusual among devices because it acts as both an:

A) Input device only
B) Output device only
C) Input and an output device
D) Storage device only
items.correct_answer: C) Input and an output device

items.prompt:
The main circuit board that connects all the components of a computer is the:

A) Monitor
B) Mouse pad
C) Printer tray
D) Motherboard

mcq_options.text: Loses its contents when the power is removed
Can only be read, never written

items.prompt:
Memory described as 'volatile' is memory that:

A) Loses its contents when the power is removed
B) Keeps its contents permanently
C) Can only be read, never written
D) Is part of the printer
items.correct_answer: A) Loses its contents when the power is removed

items.prompt:
Which of these is used to type letters and numbers into a computer?

A) Monitor
B) Keyboard
C) Speaker
D) Printer

Which of these shows output on a screen?

A) Mouse
B) Scanner
C) Monitor
D) Keyboard

The parts of a computer you can physically touch are called:

A) Software
B) Files
C) Programs
D) Hardware

The component most responsible for processing instructions in a computer is the:

A) CPU
B) Monitor
C) Mouse
D) Speaker

A small portable device that plugs into a USB port to store and transfer files is a:

A) Monitor
B) Flash drive
C) Mouse
D) Keyboard

A set of instructions that tells the computer what to do is called:

A) Hardware
B) Firmware peripheral
C) Software
D) A cable

Software that manages and controls the computer hardware is called:

A) Application software
B) Utility data
C) A spreadsheet
D) System software

Software written to perform a specific task for the user, such as a word processor, is:

A) Application software
B) System software
C) An operating system
D) A device driver

The most important system software that controls overall computer operation is the:

A) Word processor
B) Operating system
C) Spreadsheet
D) Web browser

Which of the following is a function of an operating system?

A) Browsing the internet only
B) Typing letters automatically
C) Managing files and resources
D) Drawing graphs only

An antivirus program is best classified as a type of:

A) Application software for accounting
B) Hardware
C) Operating system
D) Utility software

Microsoft Word is an example of which type of application software?

A) Word-processing software
B) Spreadsheet software
C) Database software
D) Operating system

Microsoft Excel is an example of which type of application software?

A) Word-processing software
B) Spreadsheet software
C) Presentation software
D) Web browser

Which of the following is an example of an operating system?

A) Microsoft Word
B) Microsoft Excel
C) Windows
D) PowerPoint

A program that converts an entire high-level program into machine code at once is a:

A) Interpreter
B) Spreadsheet
C) Browser
D) Compiler

A translator that converts and executes a program one line at a time is an:

A) Interpreter
B) Compiler
C) Assembler only
D) Linker

The program that translates assembly language into machine code is the:

A) Compiler
B) Assembler
C) Interpreter
D) Loader

Software developed for the specific needs of one organisation is described as:

A) Packaged software
B) Free open-source software
C) Custom (bespoke) software
D) System software

Programs permanently stored in ROM, such as the BIOS, are referred to as:

A) Application software
B) Spreadsheet macros
C) Spyware
D) Firmware

A small program that allows the operating system to communicate with a hardware device is a:

A) Device driver
B) Spreadsheet
C) Compiler
D) Browser

Programs and instructions that run on a computer are called:

A) Hardware
B) Software
C) Cables
D) Screens

A program used mainly to type and format documents is a:

A) Operating system
B) Compiler
C) Device driver
D) Word processor

Which of the following pairs are BOTH system software?

A) Operating system and device driver
B) Word processor and spreadsheet
C) Browser and game
D) Calculator and paint program

items.prompt:
Which of the following is application software rather than system software?

A) An operating system
B) A presentation package
C) A device driver
D) The BIOS

Software whose source code is freely available for users to study and modify is described as:

A) Proprietary software
B) Firmware
C) Open-source software
D) Malware

Commercial software that is owned by a company and usually requires a paid licence is:

A) Open-source software
B) Freeware with no owner
C) Public-domain software
D) Proprietary software

mcq_options.text: Allocating memory and processor time to each

items.prompt:
When several programs run at the same time, the operating system is responsible for:

A) Allocating memory and processor time to each
B) Designing the programs
C) Printing all documents automatically
D) Connecting the power supply
items.correct_answer: A) Allocating memory and processor time to each

items.prompt:
The basic information processing cycle consists of input, processing and:

A) Advertising
B) Output
C) Deletion
D) Cooling

In the information processing cycle, the input stage involves:

A) Printing final reports
B) Selling the computer
C) Entering data into the system
D) Cooling the processor
items.correct_answer: C) Entering data into the system

items.prompt:
The stage in which the computer performs calculations and manipulations on data is:

B) Storage labelling
C) Distribution
D) Processing

A) Output stage

C) Collection stage
D) Coding stage

A) Output stage
